question: ______ ranked first on Forbes’ list of ‘Highest-Paid Female Athletes 2020’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naomi Osaka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naomi Osaka is the world's highest-paid female athlete, ranked first on Forbes’ list of ‘Highest-Paid Female Athletes 2020’. **
 
• The Japanese star raked in $57.3 million in prize money and endorsements over the last year.
 
• The four-time Grand Slam champion has **commercial deals with the likes of Tag Heuer and Louis Vuitton, in addition to partnerships with Nike, Beats by Dre, and Mastercard, among others.**
 
• She also** owns equity stakes in BodyArmor and Hyperice as well as becoming an investor in the professional women's soccer team, North Carolina Courage.**
 
• She has helped raise awareness of mental health issues in sports.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Fellow tennis players** Serena Williams ($45.9 million)** and older** sister Venus ($11.3 million) **were next on the list.
 
• American** gymnast Simone Biles ($10.1 million)** and Spanish** tennis player Garbine Muguruza ($8.8 million) **rounded out the** top five.**
 
• Naomi Osaka is the Highest-Paid Woman Athlete in 2022 (Again).​

88
